description: Reorders a layer (with its subtree if it is a folder): to the top or bottom of a folder or the root, or directly above/below another layer.

above.description: Place directly above this layer (id or name)

below.description: Place directly below this layer (id or name)

layer.description: Layer UUID or its exact name

parent.description: Folder (id or name) to put the layer in; omit for the root

path.description: Path to the .comp project package (a directory ending in .comp)

to.description: Top or bottom of the destination folder (or root)

name: move_layer
title: Move layer in the stack
